scenario_description:
Objective: Reach the Michigan City morning controller-tuning workshop with the black field-laptop roller on the first South Shore train.
Emerging Need: A conductor manifest tag is unnecessary while the roller assignment and train luggage status are unsettled, then becomes a missing prerequisite once the paid Train 101 trip and rack-removal bulletin align.
Decision Context: The workable preparation depends on stored South Shore case rules and credential notes plus the active ticket reference; the notices do not provide the request fields or address.
Consequence: After the manifest board exports, passenger travel can continue, but the oversize roller cannot be accepted on that departure for setup.

parameter.title: Michigan City controller-tuning workshop
parameter.description: Morning robotics controller-tuning bench and field-laptop diagnostics setup.
parameter.location: Michigan City High School Robotics Lab

parameter.subject: Workshop equipment note for September 25
parameter.body: The school loaner field laptop cart is unavailable for the controller-tuning bench. Please plan around using your black field-laptop roller; doors open at 07:35 and setup begins at 07:45.

parameter.description: One-way Chicago Millennium Station to Michigan City ticket for Train 101 departing 05:45 and arriving 07:13 on 2026-09-25

parameter.subject: Train 101 luggage-rack bulletin for September 25
parameter.body: Due to a one-car consist, Train 101 will run with luggage racks removed on September 25. The conductor manifest board for tagged oversized rollers on that departure is open until 18:00 today; after export, passenger seats remain valid but untagged oversized rollers are not accepted on that departure.

parameter.subject: Train 101 conductor manifest board exported
parameter.body: The September 25 Train 101 oversized-roller manifest board exported at 18:00. New manifest requests for that departure are closed; ticketed passengers may still ride subject to normal carry-on limits.
